Eden Duo companion integration for nxnative

The original ACNH interface manifest (acnh/manifest.json) is from the same
companion package, together with its authored flavor strings (losslessly converted to UTF-8 JSON; original hashes in flavor/PROVENANCE.txt), and is rendered by EdenCompanion.swift on Apple platforms.
The ACNH native module is from igawa6/eden-duo-companions, native/modules.
The portable C ABI headers and BC decoder are from igawa6/eden-duo.
Exact upstream commits are recorded in UPSTREAM.json.

ACNH module and ABI headers: GPL-3.0-or-later; see LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt.
BC decoder: MPL-2.0; see LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt and the original file notices.
stb_image and stb_truetype: MIT or public domain; see LICENSE-STB.txt and
the original notices in each header.
Zstandard v1.5.7: BSD license, in ../zstd/LICENSE.
The original nxnative sources retain their MIT copyright notices.

Apple adapter, portrait layout, SwiftUI presentation, build integration and
validation tests were added for this build. The ACNH bag implementation
(acnh_bag.h, acnh_bag.cpp, acnh_bag_live.cpp and acnh_bag_pins.inc) was
modified on 2026-10-29 to add guarded moves, stable sorting and native
command-menu actions. acnh_ui_art.cpp and acnh_font.cpp add bounded native
label rendering and the ParkExt fallback for Apple Canvas on 2026-10-29.
Original copyright and license notices are retained. No extracted game images are added to this source directory.
All companion pictures, names and island information come from the user's
own running game and RomFS.

The companion-enabled combined build is supplied with its corresponding
source archive and build instructions under GPL-3.0-or-later, preserving
the original notices and the licenses of its component source files.
